prose: TechCrunch reports Melius, a New York AI platform for ad campaigns, images and video, raised $25 million: a $20 million Series A led by CRV and a $5 million seed round. It claims over $1 million annualised revenue within two months of leaving stealth in July, and its co-founder admits the first product, a performance-marketing tool, did not take off at first.
highlights: $25M total: $20M Series A led by CRV plus $5M seed.
Claims $1M+ annualised revenue in two months.
Early product did not hit at first.
